entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item.
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your order, could I get your full name and order number, please?
Mark Peterson. Order number is VF98765.

Thank you, Mark. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloFit Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered seven days ago. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
The color. It's not what I thought it would be.

I understand. Sometimes the shades can look a bit different on screen versus in person. Since you're well within the 90-day return period for gear, I can absolutely process this for you. Is the item still in its original packaging?
Yes, the box is unopened. Haven't even touched it.

Perfect. Since the box is unopened, this will be very simple. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file for you now. Do you still have access to that address?

Great. Once we receive the helmet back at our warehouse, a full refund will be processed to your original method of payment. We want to make sure you have gear you love. Getting the right color is important, not just for style but for visibility and safety on the road.
Whatever. Just make sure the email arrives.
It's been sent and should be in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mark?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
